metrics.howToMeasure: Watershed wetland (%), woody plus herbaceous, both classes required; wetlands store surface water and attenuate flow peaks. EASI scores Surface water storage on the same sum (method watershed-wetland-extent).

curve.layerName: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 71), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.13-provisional

curveCaveats: Wetland cover follows terrain: a steep watershed that never held wetland reads low on this curve without being degraded.

The reference pool's lower quartile for this metric is at or below zero, so the curve is a three-point fallback rather than a fitted shape: the bands turn on very small differences and should be read as a coarse sort, not a measurement.

The reference stations for this curve were borrowed from Level I ecoregion 8 (Eastern Temperate Forests) because this ecoregion has too few least-disturbed stations of its own. 37 least-disturbed stations from Level I 8 (Eastern Temperate Forests), 3 of them inside this ecoregion. Borrowed stations were matched to this ecoregion's streams on hydraulic conductivity, precipitation, surficial lithology. The national scale analysis supports this metric at Level III, finer than the level borrowed from, so the transfer risk is high and the expectation may not represent local conditions.

In the discrimination check this curve scored pressured stations above reference stations (area under the curve 0.18), so the score may not track condition here. Read it with the other metrics of the function.

metrics.sourceCitation: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 71), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.13-provisional
metrics.howToMeasure: EPT (mayfly/stonefly/caddisfly) taxa richness; more sensitive taxa indicate better condition.
metrics.methodContext: Collect one D-frame net sample (500 micrometer mesh) one meter downstream of each of the 11 transects at the assigned left, center or right station, and composite them. A laboratory identifies a fixed count subsample. The value is the number of mayfly, stonefly and caddisfly taxa.

curve.layerName: USEPA NRSA 2013-24 (L3 ecoregion 71), StreamCurves regional analysis, methodology 0.13-provisional

curveCaveats: Built from 17 reference sites (exploratory band, below the automated floor of 20): the point value carries wide sampling error.

The reference stations for this curve were borrowed from Level I ecoregion 8 (Eastern Temperate Forests) because this ecoregion has too few least-disturbed stations of its own. 17 least-disturbed stations from Level I 8 (Eastern Temperate Forests), 3 of them inside this ecoregion. Borrowed stations were matched to this ecoregion's streams on drainage area, channel slope, air temperature. The national scale analysis supports this metric at Level III, finer than the level borrowed from, so the transfer risk is high and the expectation may not represent local conditions.

metrics.sourceCitation: EASI fixed criteria, Nearby dam-proximity proxy
metrics.howToMeasure: Mapped dams within one mile is scored on the same fixed criteria EASI uses in every region. Good 0 mapped dams, Fair 1 mapped dam, Poor ≥2 mapped dams.
metrics.methodContext: Number of dams in the USACE National Inventory of Dams within one mile of the site. DEEP counts them. Note in the field any barrier the inventory does not show.

curve.layerName: EASI fixed criteria, Nearby dam-proximity proxy

curveCaveats: EASI lists the criteria for this metric as provisional, so the breakpoints may be revised.

criteriaSource.title: Nearby dam-proximity proxy

citations.text: USACE National Inventory of Dams

limitations: A mapped dam count is a proximity screen and cannot confirm passability or the severity of a barrier.
NID carries about 91,000 regulated dams while the National Aquatic Barrier Inventory maps over 500,000 barriers of all sizes, so zero mapped dams is frequently a false negative for passage.
Query failure is unscored, not Good.

metrics.basisStatement: Scored against a published criterion rather than against stations from this ecoregion. The criterion carries its own definition of reference, which need not match this assessment's.
metrics.basisLimit: A published criterion is not an estimate of this ecoregion's reference condition and may disagree with a reference curve where one exists.

referenceMethod.statement: Reference condition is set by a fixed landscape-pressure screen, never by a score. 27 borrow comparable least-disturbed stations from a wider region, stating the region and the transfer risk. 22 of these curves carried forward unchanged from version 5. A metric that no basis supports is not scored, and the function it would have scored is reported as unassessed.

insufficientReferenceSupport.statement: Insufficient reference support. No station pool, from this ecoregion's own least-disturbed streams or from a wider region under the regional screen, holds enough comparable stations with a value for this metric and passes acceptance. The local reference: 3 usable stations, below the floor of 10. This ecoregion under the regional screen: In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough. The Level II pool (8.3): In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough and the source promoted sites systematically. The NARS-9 pool (SAP): In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough and the source promoted sites systematically. The Level I pool (8): In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough and the source promoted sites systematically. No other basis supports it either. National reference: 19 matched national donors, but in the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough. 8 national donors inside the comparability envelope, below the floor of 10. Modeled reference: The model registry holds no approved specification for this metric. Published benchmark: The published criteria STAF draws on include none for this metric. No curve was built and the metric is not scored.
